cosplay.character: the Chosen Undead in Elite Knight armour

cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — standing close to a high shelf or line; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the upper gallery of a Han-era house — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a shopping mall atrium with a fountain and glass railings — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a night observatory under an open dome — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a smartphone at chest height; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
